About Milk frother

We started in a small kitchen with a broken whisk and a lot of opinions about foam. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, we shipped our hundred-thousandth frother.

Our story

Foam is air held in a thin film of milk protein. Fat makes it rich and slows it down; protein makes it hold. We tuned the whisk speed to get both.
